summary: Arbitrary code execution via untrusted pickle deserialization in MLflow model loading
details: MLflow before 2.11.0 contains an unsafe deserialization flaw allowing remote code execution via malicious model artifacts with embedded Python pickle opcodes.

summary: Arbitrary code execution in PythonAstREPLTool via unconstrained AST execution
details: The PythonAstREPLTool class in LangChain Experimental executes arbitrary Python code supplied by the LLM without adequate sandboxing, enabling host takeover.

summary: Server-Side Request Forgery and Path Traversal in vLLM model download API
details: vLLM allows unauthenticated callers to specify arbitrary file schemes or relative paths during model initialization, resulting in local file disclosure and SSRF.

summary: Arbitrary file write via crafted Modelfile layer digest path traversal
details: Ollama versions prior to 0.1.34 are vulnerable to relative path traversal when extracting model layers, allowing overwriting of system executables.

summary: Arbitrary code execution via unescaped query execution in PandasQueryEngine
details: LlamaIndex PandasQueryEngine invokes eval() on LLM-generated expressions without adequate AST validation, permitting execution of imported system primitives.

summary: Insecure deserialization of arbitrary executable bytecode via torch.load
details: Loading untrusted PyTorch checkpoints via torch.load() without weights_only=True permits arbitrary Python opcode execution via GLOBAL and REDUCE opcodes.
